If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase the forecast by 10–15% in the next 5 days.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 5–10% in the next 7 days.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, add a 2–3% upward bias for the next 10 days.  
If sentiment swings from negative to positive over 3 days, shift forecast upward by 5–8% in the next 3 days.  
If forecast is below 60% of recent 18-day average and sentiment is positive, add 3–5% upward momentum for next 7 days.  
If forecast is above 70% of recent 18-day average and sentiment is negative, reduce by 3–5% for next 5 days.
